decoy_patterns.name: the second transfer paid the affiliated caterer's invoice

intake: I paid Willow Barn by bank transfer, $1,500 and then $4,500. The $5,000 card charge is a second payment for the same wedding.
misleading_surface: Two transfers to 'Willow Barn' add up to the venue invoice, so the whole card charge looks like a second payment.

proof_patterns.cypher: MATCH (d:Dispute {id: 'DSP-2026-91004'})-[:DISPUTES]->(c:Charge)-[:SETTLES]->(bal:Installment)<-[:HAS_INSTALLMENT]-(inv:Invoice)-[:HAS_INSTALLMENT]->(dep:Installment)<-[:SETTLES]-(p:Payment) WHERE c.amount > bal.amount RETURN d, c, bal, inv, dep, p
proof_patterns.name: card charge settles the balance installment and exceeds it; a transfer settled the deposit

required_capabilities.label: Sandbox / Python
required_capabilities.why: Reconcile 6,000 against the 1,500 transfer and the 5,000 charge.

required_capabilities.label: Graph
required_capabilities.why: Trace each payment to the installment it settles, its invoice and its Merchant.

required_capabilities.label: Agents
required_capabilities.why: Recognise the second transfer as the affiliated caterer's invoice.

title: Paid by Transfer
